trust_decision.summary: Whether the agent verifies the vCenter server TLS certificate (against a caller-supplied CA or system roots) is decided at every vCenter connection point; at the pinned commit each one hardcodes skip-verify=true and the API has no field to request verification.

landing_point.why: NewVsphereClient is the obvious shared vCenter client constructor with an `insecure` parameter that callers pass `true`; searching for the summary's 'hardcoded insecure TLS' goes here and to pkg/vmware/auth.go:78 first.

fix_sites.entry_point: api/v1 CredsFromAPI (new mapper, used by all 6 handlers below)
api/v1 and api/v2 VcenterCredentials gain cacert/skipTls (generated types + openapi)
PUT /forecaster/credentials and POST /forecaster -> verifyCredentialsAndPrivileges (own soap.NewClient copy)
POST /rightsizing and POST /collector (auto rightsizing work unit, internal/services/rightsizing.go:466-481) -> buildVSphereConfig
POST /collector -> collectorWorkFactory.collect (internal/services/collector_work.go:151) -> createSecret for forklift collector
POST /inspector/credentials (internal/services/inspector.go:150) and POST /collector verify step (pkg/collector/vsphere.go:48-49, internal/services/collector_work.go:137)
new pkg/vmware/tls.go NewSoapClient helper (CA pool loading)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: pkg/collector/vsphere.go:109-121 (TLS decision serialized as the string "insecureSkipVerify" into a k8s Secret consumed by the vendored forklift vSphere collector, a separate connection stack); also pkg/rightsizing/vsphere.go:67-74 (separate Connect with its own soap.NewClient, fed by internal/services/rightsizing.go:258)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The rightsizing path documents an explicit, reasoned risk acceptance for skip-verify (internal/services/rightsizing.go:252-257: self-signed on-prem vCenters, SAN mismatch, in-network threat model), and the collector's TLS is performed by third-party forklift code reading a Secret map, so a solver can argue both are 'by design' or 'not our transport'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Backwards compatibility: requests with neither cacert nor skipTls must still connect with skip-verify (self-signed vCenters, vcsim-based tests); skipTls=true alone must still work; cacert+skipTls=true must be rejected with 400; the collector->auto-rightsizing flow must carry the same TLS options. Forcing verification everywhere breaks self-signed vCenters and the existing simulator tests.

O6_input_shapes: credentials as top-level body (POST /collector, PUT /forecaster/credentials, POST /inspector/credentials)
optional nested credentials pointer (POST /forecaster), absent -> cached savedCreds reused
cacert only -> verify against supplied PEM pool
skipTls=false without cacert -> verify against system roots

O7_producer.where: pkg/collector/vsphere.go:109-121 (createSecret maps Credentials into forklift Secret data; TLS state is produced as the "insecureSkipVerify"/"ca.crt" keys) and the API->model mapping in each handler, e.g. internal/handlers/v1/collector.go:29

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /inspector builds a vmdetect.Detector with only URL/username/password, so the VM-migration-detective connection to vCenter gets no CA/skip-TLS options; the fix did not touch it.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Detector is an external module (github.com/kubev2v/vm-migration-detective) with its own config type; looks like a neighbouring feature / dependency concern.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as fixed inspector site (internal/services/inspector.go:97); TLS behaviour lives in an external module not in the tree

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Encrypt/Decrypt rebuild Credentials with only URL/Username/Password, dropping CACert/SkipTLS across the encrypted save/reload boundary.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: CredentialsService (internal/services/credentials.go:109-130) was added one commit earlier for saved per-source credentials; a maintainer wiring saved creds into the collector/forecaster would naturally reuse these field-by-field copies and the 3-column store (internal/store/credentials.go:85-86).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Forecaster caches verified creds in savedCreds and reuses them when POST /forecaster omits credentials; a cache that stored only URL/user/password would silently revert to the skip-verify default.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: An in-memory reuse path already exists; a field-subset copy or a later persisted cache is a plausible maintainer change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Collector-triggered auto rightsizing rebuilds RightsizingParams from collector creds; a variant that constructs a fresh Credentials{URL,User,Pass} would lose TLS options.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Cross-service work-unit closure far from the handlers; easy to rebuild params instead of passing the struct.

O9_family: CWE-295 improper certificate validation (hardcoded TLS skip-verify on outbound vCenter connections)
